name: Luminova Ventures
decision_note: Prague-based dual-use/deep-tech VC fund (Luxembourg SCSp) that only 'opened to investors' in January 2026; no fund close and no dated investment by Luminova could be found, and its undated Israeli portfolio appears to come via the Awz Global partnership - unverified.

evidence.quote: Luminova Ventures strategically invests in emerging technologies that secure our digital future and national sovereignty.
Our mission is to identify and support breakthrough innovations in deep tech, AI, cybersecurity, quantum and defense technologies, providing startups with capital, support and access to our network.
Luminova Ventures chce investovat do řešení od datové analytiky a kyberbezpečnosti po AI či postkvantovou kryptografii.
Cílí na ranější fáze a plánuje mezinárodní dosah napříč Evropou, Izraelem a USA.
Fond má český původ, je však strukturálně založen v Lucembursku.
A new investment fund, Luminova Ventures, is being established in the Czech Republic with a focus on supporting dual-use and deep-tech technologies in defense, security, and societal resilience.
AI-native security platform protecting GenAI, LLM, and computer vision systems from adversarial attacks, prompt injection, data leakage, and misuse.

analyst_notes: Discovered via Lupa.cz (2026-01-21, fund launch). I3 rests on the fund opening to investors (launch, 2026-01-21); no dated deal announcement was found. I2: the website portfolio lists seven Israeli companies (Satya, New Photonics, Octopus, CitrusX, DeepKeep, Cyberridge, SkyForce) without investment dates; DeepKeep (seed) itemised from its portfolio detail page. Some portfolio companies are at Series B/C, possibly via the strategic partnership with Awz Global, so stage is derived (Lupa: earlier stages; portfolio mostly seed/Series A). Structure: Luxembourg Luminova Ventures Fund I SCSp with Luminova Ventures GP S.à r.l. as registered AIFM (website legal disclosures); Prague office at Štěpánská 14; Czech company Luminova a.s. (same address, statutory body includes partners Lukáš Šebesta, Jan Balatka and Olga Chabr Grillová per ARES VR) assumed to be the local advisory/management company. Ticket and fund size not disclosed. [revision 2026-10-25 after review: decision include -> unverified (E8). Under the revised I3 a fund 'newly opened to investors' (e6, 2026-01-21) is a launch, not a close; the own release says the fund 'is being established' and works with a 'pre-selected portfolio'. Re-checked the website (insights list, newsletter archive, portfolio pages) and searched the web once more: no first close, no LP commitment and no dated deal by Luminova; the seven portfolio companies are undated and DeepKeep's public rounds name Awz Ventures and OurCrowd, not Luminova (reviewer), so a Luminova investment (I2) is not shown from public sources. Re-screen when a close or a dated deal is announced.]
